title: BoneSword
description: Adds a powerful bone sword to Minecraft
body:
### Bone Sword
is a simple yet fun mod that adds a new weapon made of bones. The sword is slightly stronger than a stone sword, making it a good early‑game upgrade. It comes with an easy crafting recipe and applies a special effect when hitting enemies, adding extra flavor to combat.

This mod is lightweight, straightforward, and designed for players who want a small but cool addition to their survival experience.

Requirements:

Fabric Loader

[Fabric Api](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api?version=1.21.8#download)

[Cloth Config API](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config?version=1.21.8&loader=fabric#download)

Make sure both Fabric API and Cloth Config API are installed for the same game version to ensure proper functionality.
